retrieval.method: Direct retrieval from the official Icelandic Ministry of Justice Reglugerðasafn instrument pages; exact response bytes are retained in the Monitor local research archive at the paths above.
retrieval.retained_source: Official Icelandic legal text in full, not a link-only source and not an independently authored summary.

copyright_basis.scope: Article 9 excludes laws, regulations, government instructions, judgments and similar official documents, including official translations, from protection under the Act. This conversion applies that rule only to the official legal text; it does not assert reuse rights for the publisher website, interface, database, or unrelated content.

conversion.method: Python standard-library HTMLParser builds a DOM-like tree and selects the official .boxbody. It records the source instrument number, then converts the title, article headings, paragraphs, ordered lists and signature paragraphs in document order.
preserved: All Icelandic words, punctuation, numerals and paragraph order in the published instrument text.
Article headings and the title as headings.
Emphasis and strong emphasis as Markdown emphasis.
Ordered-list markers as shown by the source HTML list-style type and start attributes, including lower-alpha markers.
Signature date, signatory names and Gazette publication date.
Source URL, publisher attribution, publication date, retrieval date, legal-text reuse basis, source-byte SHA-256 and text status in a clearly separate provenance header.
normalization: HTML character references are decoded to Unicode.
Runs of layout whitespace inside a text line are collapsed to one space; leading and trailing layout whitespace is removed.
HTML paragraph and heading boundaries become Markdown block boundaries; br elements become line breaks.
Source page navigation, record metadata chrome, related-instrument links, PDF download links, scripts, print controls and footer boilerplate are excluded.
not_performed: No translation, paraphrase, substantive correction, or amendment integration into Regulation 540/2017.
No claim that these three amendment instruments constitute a current consolidated Regulation 540/2017.
conversion.replay: Run the script with each source id and its archived captured HTML; generated text must match the committed Markdown byte-for-byte apart from the unchanged checked_at value.

known_limitations: These are three specific 2026 amendment instruments. Older amendments and a current full consolidation of Regulation 540/2017 have not been locally reproduced here.

The underlying captured HTML is stored in the Monitor local-only research archive, not copied into this source pack. The source pack retains the complete legal text and hashes both captured HTML and converted Markdown in source-acceptance.json.
The source page displays both an instrument date and a Gazette publication date; each is preserved as shown where available. The distinction is not silently harmonized.
